messages:
alex: quick heads-up — i'm spinning up a small experiment: adding a 'marginal overlay' to the unit-econ card so you can toggle between amortized vs marginal token cost per route. want eyeballs on UX and telemetry sampling plan.

maya: that sounds useful. is this just a visualization or will it change how we attribute cache savings?

alex: visualization first. idea is hover shows marginal cost delta if we turned off prefix cache for the last 24h, plus an estimated SLA impact for high-p95 routes. not changing attribution pipeline yet.

dan: for telemetry: we should avoid doubling ingest. suggest sample_rate=0.05 for marginal traces, and compute delta via coarse aggregator + replays for high-impact tenants.

ajulia: product note — if the overlay shows a big negative (savings) we need a CTA to open a route-level what-if in the console. UX: two quick actions: open what-if sim, request deeper audit.

sasha: what about batching/bursting effects? marginal token cost can flip depending on batch window. we should surface the batch config used to compute the estimate.

alex: agreed. plan: attach batch_window_ms and sample histogram. sample schema:
```
{ sample_rate: 0.05, batch_window_ms: 10, kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.72 }
```
show these as small key/value chips.

dan: also include model_variant and quantization level — those are huge for delta. e.g., v2-int8 vs v2-fp16.

billing-bot: reminder: any UI that hints at charge changes should have the phrase "estimates only" and link to billing docs.

maya: thumbs up. on rollout — prefer canary to 1% of routes with >1k qps and 24h sampling. toggle behind feature-flag and console opt-in.

ajulia: ops question — who owns the canary guardrails? will platform set the default sampling and product enable the CTA?

alex: platform owns sampling defaults and compute job. product owns CTA + what-if UI. we'll coordinate on the feature flag name: econ.marginal_overlay_v1.

sasha: implementation nit: do not recompute full token attribution for sampled traces in realtime. precompute delta in nightly job and stream small deltas to the UI for quick hover. on-demand replays for the audit flow.

dan: +1. that keeps the realtime path cheap. also add a cheap delta estimate using stovepipe heuristics for immediate display (and then replace with exact after replay).

maya: acceptance criteria for launch: 1) overlay shows delta within 10% of replay for 90% of sampled routes, 2) no >2% increase in cost for the console backend during canary, 3) CTA launches what-if sim with prefilled batch params.

ajulia: I'll file the UX ticket and link mocks. alex, can you add the telemetry contract (fields + sample_rate) here so infra can sign off?

alex: adding a quick contract in thread: fields = ["route_id","model_variant","token_count","kv_cache_hit","batch_window_ms","sample_rate","estimated_marginal_cost","amortized_cost"]. we'll use sample_rate=0.05 default, canary 0.01 for low-qps routes.

sasha: sounds solid. one last check: make sure the overlay respects tenant privacy — strip PII and only show tenant-aggregated deltas unless tenant opted-in.

billing-bot: compliance reminder: any per-tenant cost preview must be disabled for GDPR regions until we have explicit consent flow.

alex: noted. i'll draft the PR and feature-flag plan. will post link to PR + mocks in this thread when available. thanks for the quick sync :thumbsup:

maya: thanks — excited to see the hover sparklines.

dan: ping me on the infra PR, i'll review the sampling job.

ajulia: i'll attach the mock here once ready.
